tools.name: search_publication
tools.description: Search Leonidas Tsementzis's public articles, talks, photographs, and background information. Matching publication details and canonical paths are returned, and a visible result panel is displayed; this never contacts anyone or changes site content.

query.description: Words or a phrase to find in titles, summaries, topics, and excerpts.

type.description: Optional publication type. Use all to search every public item.

limit.description: Maximum number of returned and visible results. Defaults to 10.
